justification: Descriptive, balanced pilot: 2 images from each of 13 year-sensor groups and each class. 5.2 times the earlier 10-image panels; not a powered population estimate.

inference.scope: Synchronized model forward only; tensor already on device; excludes decode, preprocessing, transfers, UI and report creation.

xai.target: predicted class at threshold 0.5, fixed before perturbation
xai.shap: DeepExplainer with additivity check; GradientExplainer fallback (200 samples, batch 8), actual path and warnings recorded per image
xai.baseline: zero in normalized RGB space (ImageNet mean)
xai.iou: exact top 20% pixel count, not percentile threshold ties
xai.timing_scope: Synchronized explainer setup and heatmap computation; excludes rendering, disk I/O and faithfulness scoring. SHAP includes a failed DeepExplainer attempt when fallback is used.

historical_metrics: Existing full-test JSON metrics are retained, not re-estimated from this balanced XAI sample.
